## Summary
AI/ML Engineer with 3.8+ years designing and deploying machine learning, computer vision, and agentic AI systems across the full lifecycle. Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems with LangGraph (intent classification, rule-based task routing, planner-style orchestration across specialist agents) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines backed by a FAISS vector database, with rule-based guardrails for safety, compliance, and PII redaction. Proficient in Python for backend AI systems and RESTful microservices using FastAPI, with production deployment experience using Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and MLflow across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform. Google Cloud Certified Professional Machine Learning Engineer and Microsoft Certified Azure Data Scientist Associate. Currently pursuing a Master of Computer Applications specialized in AI/ML.

## Featured Project
Multi-Agent Healthcare Triage / Support Assistant (05/2026 – 07/2026)
- Built with Python, LangGraph, FastAPI, FAISS, Docker.
- LangGraph-orchestrated assistant with intent classification and planner-style routing across three specialist agents: a FAISS-backed RAG question-answering agent, a tool-calling scheduling agent, and an emergency-escalation agent.
- Rule-based guardrail layer for diagnosis-language mitigation and PII redaction.
- Exposed as a FastAPI microservice with a Streamlit dashboard, containerized with Docker, validated by a 14-test suite via GitHub Actions CI/CD.
